query_text: which came first the walking dead comic or show

message.content:
Based on my search, **The Walking Dead comic came first**.

The comic book series debuted on **October 8, 2003**, published by Image Comics and created by writer Robert Kirkman and artist Tony Moore.

The TV show adaptation came much later, premiering on **October 31, 2010** on AMC. The show was announced in August 2009, with filming beginning in May 2010.

So the comic predates the TV show by approximately **7 years**.
